text: Please accept this letter as my request for your support seeking the installation of All Way Stop Controls (stop signs) on the streets and at the intersections noted below. In all instances, these requests are the result of serious concerns expressed by parents of children attending nearby school (Clairlea Public School). Motorists using the street along which this school is situated are driving in such a manner as to pose safety concerns for the children. It is clear that the presence of an all-way stop control at this intersection would contribute significantly to the safety of the students crossing these residential streets. It should be noted that other actions are also being undertaken including periodic speed enforcement by Toronto Police. However, an all-way stop control is required.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Edge Park Avenue and Karnwood Drive.
